" alt="Tiny wearing a black ribbon and ruffled skirt" draggable="false"><img id="sea" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Sea the hooded green-eyed cat" draggable="false">
<div id="speech"><span id="speechName" class="speaker">TINY</span><span id="speechText">Who opened the raccoon enclosure?</span></div>
<div id="guestChip" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div id="netBoard"><div id="boardTop"><span>🥅 NET WAVE <strong id="waveNumber">1/3</strong></span><span>🦝 <strong id="caught">0</strong>/12</span><span>💨 <strong id="escaped">0</strong></span><span id="keyCue" aria-live="polite">🔑 TAP THE KEY!</span><span>⏱ <strong id="clock">17.0</strong></span></div><div id="holeGrid"></div></div><div id="countdown" aria-live="polite">3</div><div id="flash" role="status"></div></section>
<div id="powers"><button id="puppy">🥺 +5 SEC<br>30 ENERGY</button><button id="raccoons">🦝 AUTO NET<br>60 ENERGY</button><button id="rage">🍗 NET BOOST<br>100 ENERGY</button></div>
<footer id="bottom"><div id="copy"><div id="kicker">STAGE 3 • RACCOON INCIDENT</div><div id="heading">Raccoons, Everywhere!</div><div id="story">A terrible sound is coming from the enclosure.</div></div><div id="actions"></div></footer>
<div id="report" aria-live="polite"><h2 id="reportTitle">Wave Complete!</h2><p id="reportText"></p></div><div id="toast" role="status"></div>
<div id="guide" role="dialog" aria-label="Stage 3 help"><button id="closeGuide" aria-label="Close help">✕</button><h2>🦝 NET THE RACCOONS</h2><p>Watch the <strong>3, 2, 1, GO!</strong> countdown before each wave. Tap raccoons as they pop out of the nine holes. Two can appear together, and you can catch them with two fingers.</p><p>The raccoon with 🔑 moves faster, but stays up long enough to catch. <strong>Baba sometimes peeks up too. Bonk him for bonus chaos, but he does not count as a raccoon catch!</strong> Missing raccoons creates hilarious consequences, not a game over.</p><button class="btn" id="guideGo">GOT IT ✓</button></div>
</div>
<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a),choose=a=>a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];
const DIALOGUE=[
 ['Tiny','Okay. Who opened the raccoon enclosure?'],
 ['Sea','Technically? The button did. I merely supported it.'],
 ['Catalyst','Those are my cousins. They do this.'],
 ['Mo','Tiny. The corner. NOW.'],
 ['Savvy','*The longest, most deeply disappointed sigh.*'],
 ['Tiny','WAIT. ONE OF THEM HAS THE TRAIN KEYS!']
];
const WAVES=3,REAL_PER_WAVE=4,HATS_PER_WAVE=1,PLAY_MS=17000,COUNT_MS=3000,GO_MS=650;
let g={},phase='intro',dialogIndex=0,round=null,raf=0,lastFrame=0,toastTimer=0,flashTimer=0,spriteTimer=0,pauseAt=0,guideWasOpen=false;
const raccoonSVG=`<svg viewBox="0 0 100 115" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><radialGradient id="fur" cx=".32" cy=".25" r=".85"><stop stop-color="#d0c9bd"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#a7a3a1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#666e77"/></radialGradient><linearGradient id="mask" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#50505e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#242936"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M19 38L12 4Q24 2 40 26L63 26Q80 2 88 5L82 39" fill="#aab0ab" stroke="#42454e" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M20 24L18 11L37 30M67 30L82 13L80 29" fill="#d8b7ad"/><path d="M27 84Q5 99 23 113M77 84Q95 100 77 113" stroke="#59636a" stroke-width="18" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="59" rx="45" ry="46" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#565960" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M8 54Q15 30 50 36Q85 30 91 55Q80 72 60 67L41 67Q19 71 8 54Z" fill="url(#mask)"/><ellipse cx="30" cy="54" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#fff4df"/><ellipse cx="70" cy="54" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#fff4df"/><ellipse cx="32" cy="55" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#262436"/><ellipse cx="68" cy="55" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#262436"/><circle cx="30" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="white"/><circle cx="66" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="white"/><path d="M29 71Q50 62 71 71Q77 96 50 99Q23 94 29 71Z" fill="#efe8dd"/><path d="M43 76L57 76L50 84Z" fill="#4d4145"/><path d="M50 84Q50 91 41 91M50 84Q51 91 59 91" fill="none" stroke="#60545b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M20 91Q10 89 13 108Q25 112 34 102M66 102Q77 112 88 107Q91 91 81 91" fill="#777780" stroke="#54565f" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M16 38Q23 22 40 33M62 34Q79 21 85 39" stroke="#f2e8db" stroke-opacity=".7" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/></svg>`;
function now(){return performance.now()}
function shuffle(a){const z=a.slice();for(let i=z.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[z[i],z[j]]=[z[j],z[i]]}return z}
function initial(){return {score:0,energy:35,caught:0,escaped:0,hats:0,misses:0,key:false,keyWave:Math.floor(Math.random()*3),plan:'nuggies',waveResults:[],completed:false,paused:false,autoNet:0,boost:0,seen:0}}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('tiny-stage3-art-trial-v1',JSON.stringify({best:Math.max(g.score,Number(localStorage.getItem('tiny-stage3-best')||0)),lastRun:Date.now()}))}catch{}}
function hud(){$('chaos').textContent=g.score.toLocaleString();$('energy').textContent='⚡ '+g.energy+'/100';$('energyFill').style.width=g.energy+'%';$('caught').textContent=g.caught;$('escaped').textContent=g.escaped;for(const [id,n] of [['puppy',30],['raccoons',60],['rage',100]])$(id).disabled=g.energy<n||g.paused}
function points(n){g.score+=n;hud()}
function earn(n){g.energy=Math.min(100,g.energy+n);hud()}
function setPanel(title,body,kicker='STAGE 3 • RACCOON INCIDENT'){$('heading').textContent=title;$('story').textContent=body;$('kicker').textContent=kicker}
// Keep Sea for his line; Catalyst takes the companion position when introduced.
const originalSeaSprite=$('sea').getAttribute('src');
const catalystSprite='data:image/webp;base64,';
const moSprite='data:image/webp;base64,';
const babaPopSprite='data:image/webp;base64,';
function showCompanion(who){
 const sprite=$('sea');
 const cat=who==='Catalyst',mo=who==='Mo';
 sprite.src=mo?moSprite:cat?catalystSprite:originalSeaSprite;
 sprite.alt=mo?'Mo: curly dark hair, black glasses and a black hoodie':cat?'Catalyst: orange tabby cat wearing a dark hoodie and purple-blue sunglasses':'Sea: green-eyed cat in a neon-green hood';
 sprite.classList.toggle('catalyst',cat);
 sprite.classList.toggle('mo',mo);
}

function say(who,what){$('speechName').textContent=who.toUpperCase();$('speechText').textContent=what;$('speech').className='from-'+(who.toLowerCase()==='tiny'?'tiny':'sea');setPanel(who,what,'UTW INCIDENT IN PROGRESS • '+(dialogIndex||1)+' / '+DIALOGUE.length)}
function buttons(items){$('actions').replaceChildren();items.forEach(([label,fn,secondary])=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn'+(secondary?' secondary':'');b.textContent=label;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(g.paused)return;fn()});$('actions').append(b)})}
function toast(t,ms=1350){const n=$('toast');n.textContent=t;n.style.display='block';clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>n.style.display='none',ms)}
function flash(text,ms=850){const n=$('flash');n.textContent=text;n.classList.remove('show');void n.offsetWidth;n.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(flashTimer);flashTimer=setTimeout(()=>n.classList.remove('show'),ms)}
function guest(name){const card=$('guestChip');const icons={'Catalyst':'🐈','Mo':'🌸','Savvy':'🐕'};card.innerHTML='<b>'+(icons[name]||'🦝')+' '+name.toUpperCase()+'</b>is commenting on the disaster';card.classList.add('show')}
function clearVisual(){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;round=null;$('scene').className='';$('report').classList.remove('show');$('netBoard').classList.remove('show');$('countdown').classList.remove('show','go');$('flash').classList.remove('show');$('guestChip').classList.remove('show');$('powers').classList.remove('show');$('tiny').src='data:image/webp;base64,
